verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Physical-layer coax: 75 Ω cable, 0.5-0.6 Vpp transmitter output, 0.2 V minimum receiver input, RCA / BNC connector, ~10 m max distance.
Physical-layer optical: Toslink (JIS F05 / EIAJ) connector and fibre, identical content to coax, ~10 m max distance.
Bi-phase Mark Code encoding: transition at every bit boundary; mid-bit transition for '1', no mid-bit transition for '0'.
Preamble X / Y / Z waveforms: 8 BMC cells each, three-cell-long pulse intentionally violates BMC, in both starting-polarity variants.
Subframe length = 32 BMC-bit-times; field layout Preamble (0-3) + Aux (4-7) + Audio (8-27) + V (28) + U (29) + C (30) + P (31).
Frame = 2 subframes (channel A + channel B); block = 192 frames; first frame uses Z, others use X on channel A.
Audio sample 20-bit LSB-first within bits 8-27; optional 24-bit using Aux.
Validity bit V = 0 → sample passes to PCM DAC; V = 1 → DAC muted, sample routed to IEC 61937 demux or treated as fault.
User-data bit U accumulated to 192-bit user-data word per channel per block.
Channel-status bit C accumulated to 192-bit channel-status word per channel per block; identical between channel A and channel B in consumer mode.
Parity bit P = even parity over bits 4-30 of the same subframe.
Consumer/Pro bit (byte 0 bit 0) = 0 for S/PDIF, = 1 for AES3.
PCM/Compressed bit (byte 0 bit 1) routes the receiver to PCM DAC or IEC 61937 demux.
Copy-restrict SCMS bit (byte 0 bit 2) and copy-permit interpretation.
Channel-count bit (byte 0 bit 3): 0 = 2 channels, 1 = 4 channels.
Pre-emphasis bit (byte 0 bit 5) detected and applied at the downstream DAC.
Channel-status mode (byte 0 bits 6-7) zero (default) interpretation; non-zero values undefined.
Audio source category (byte 1 bits 0-6) round-trip through link.
L-bit (byte 1 bit 7) interpretation per category; CD-DA recording-prevention via 4-10 Hz toggling of byte 0 bit 2.
Source and channel numbers (byte 2 bits 0-3 and 4-7).
Sampling-frequency code (byte 3 bits 0-3): 44.1 / 48 / 32 kHz primary codes.
Clock-accuracy code (byte 3 bits 4-5): 50 ppm / 1000 ppm / variable pitch.
Word-length code (byte 4 bit 0): 20-bit vs 24-bit.
Sample-length code (byte 4 bits 1-3): 0 / 1-4 / 5 values.
EAN-13 code (bytes 5-10 + byte 11 bits 0-3) round-trip.
ISRC field (byte 14 bits 4-7 through byte 21) round-trip.
IEC 61937 encapsulation: two 16-bit sync words, bitstream type/length/validity, padding, V = 1 on every subframe, carrier ≈ 64 × symbol rate.
Receiver lock acquisition: time to BMC lock + subframe alignment + block alignment after power-on / cable plug-in.
Receiver re-sync after a brief BMC interruption (cable-bounce, RF interference burst).
Receiver tolerates inverted-polarity BMC stream (both starting-polarity preamble forms).
Jitter at recovered clock — verify within DAC tolerance after any re-clocking buffer.
Variable-pitch operation (byte 3 bits 4-5 = 01): receiver tracks drifting BMC rate within its lock range.
fields.notes: IEC 60958 does not include a formal verification testbench; the categories above are derived from the spec's protocol-layer rules, channel-status byte layout, physical-layer levels, and IEC 61937 encapsulation rules. A practical S/PDIF compliance suite typically adds: a golden-PCM reference at each sample rate, a golden Dolby AC-3 / DTS / Dolby TrueHD bitstream for IEC 61937 mode, sinusoidal sweep through the DAC for jitter SNR, and a long-soak cable test for long-term lock stability.
